last_round.quote: Ubicloud also today announced that it has raised a $16 million seed round, which closed in early January. Among the investors are Y Combinator and 500 Emerging Europe, as well as a number of angel investors.

note: Founded 2023 in San Francisco by Umur Cubukcu, Ozgun Erdogan, and Daniel Farina (the team behind Citus Data, acquired by Microsoft in 2019). Open-source cloud (compute, block storage, networking, managed Postgres, K8s, AI inference) that runs on bare-metal providers like Hetzner, Leaseweb, and AWS Bare Metal. YC W24 batch confirmed via ycombinator.com/companies/ubicloud (same domain ubicloud.com), status Active as of check date. TechCrunch (2024-03-05) reported a $16M seed round that closed early January 2024, backed by Y Combinator and 500 Emerging Europe plus angels; article said company had 10 employees at the time (SF, Amsterdam, Istanbul). No subsequent funding round or revenue/ARR disclosure was found within the research window.
